exposure: Laparoscopic surgical treatment (partial bladder resection, shaving)
outcome: Symptom improvement (dysmenorrhea, lower abdominal pain, dysuria, dyspareunia)
cohort: The study included 42 patients with bladder endometriosis who underwent laparoscopic surgery, identified from a review of 11,714 surgical reports of endometriosis laparoscopies.
finding: Laparoscopic surgical treatment for bladder endometriosis, including partial bladder resection and shaving, was effective, with 90% of patients reporting general symptom improvement and 100% reporting improvement in dysuria, with low complication risk.
